import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a user post. Placeholders: # {username}, {post_title}, {post_body}, {tags} USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_title}

Posted by: {username}

{post_body}
{tags}
""" def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML representation of a user-generated post. Args: username: Name of the user who created the post. post_title: Title of the post. post_body: Main content of the post. tags: List of tag strings. Returns: A string containing well‑formed HTML with escaped user input. """ # Escape all user-supplied data to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Render tags as elements; escape each tag individually safe_tags = ' '.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tags ) # Format the final HTML using the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags ) # Strip leading/trailing whitespace for a clean output return rendered.strip()
